info.sub_ename: MACHINE LEARNING AND MARKETING DATA ANALYSIS WITH PYTHON

description.sub_name: 機器學習與Python行銷數據分析
description.sub_ename: MACHINE LEARNING AND MARKETING DATA ANALYSIS WITH PYTHON
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在應用機器學習技術於行銷數據的分析。運用機器學習之監督式學習與非監督式學習演算法，透過Python深入分析企業內部或網路外部的商業數據，協助企業制定以數據為基礎的行銷策略。
description.describe_eh: The aims of this course is to apply machine learning techniques to the analysis of marketing data. Use the supervised learning and unsupervised learning algorithms of machine learning to analyze the data inside the company or outside the network through Python to assist the enterprise in formulating data-based marketing strategies.

targets.describe_ch: 學習 Python 程式語言
理解機器學習基本原理與運用演算法於數據分析
targets.describe_en: Comprehending the principal of machine learning and applying the ML algorithm to the data analysis.

2.Data Science from Scratch中文版：用Python學資料科學 Joel Grus著 碁峰
